summary: Content and copy updates for Safety Notice, Privacy, and home screen disclaimers aimed at a child-focused app with adult supervision guidance.

existing_features.title: Update the Safety Notice page to include: (1) an added emergency guidance paragraph block that says: "If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number" followed by "In many countries this is 112 or 911." followed by "Ask a grown-up to help you call."; and (2) an added age range line that says: "Designed for children ages 4–12 with adult supervision."
Update the Privacy & Safety page to add the exact line: “The app works fully offline and does not send information anywhere.”
Shorten the home (main menu) screen disclaimer text to only: “Not medical advice.”
Update the grown-ups entry point label on the Menu screen to: “Parents, Teachers & Caregivers Only”.
Update the help message copy to: “Show this to a trusted adult”.
